figurative_meaning_en: The afterlife or the realm after death
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরলোকগমনের আগে সব দায়িত্ব পালন করো।
example_sentences_in_english: His soul has gone to the afterlife.
Fulfill all your duties before departing to the great beyond.
note: Often used in contexts of condolence or philosophical discussions about mortality in Bengali literature and daily speech.
